title: bug: collectTaskPathTiers throws on a truthy non-iterable step file list and splits a string into characters
description: Repro (probe in a Linux snapshot, found by task-f943b687): util/attributionTiers.ts collectTaskPathTiers spreads `[...(step.affectedFiles || []), ...(step.newFiles || []), ...(step.modifiedFiles || [])]`. With newFiles: 7 or {a:1} it throws "(step.newFiles || []) is not iterable", which fails get_commit_scope for EVERY task that has that peer; with newFiles: 'src/str.ts' it plans the characters 's','r','c','t'. The header and get_commit_scope promise a peer's junk never fails another task's scope. Fix with Array.isArray guards (null/false already tolerated) plus a test; completedStepFiles has the same unguarded `s.modifiedFiles || s.affectedFiles || []` flatMap.
definitionOfDone: collectTaskPathTiers and collectAssertedPaths return the valid entries and never throw for a non-array affectedFiles/newFiles/modifiedFiles (number, object, string)
Tests pin each shape in attributionTiers.test.ts and one get_commit_scope case with a junk peer
